system.description:
Why haunt a battlefield alone? The Eidolon of Reanimation raises a shambling host of Soul Touched undead, swarming foes and reaping the fallen to swell its ranks.

LEVEL 3

Reanimated Soul. Soul Twist can instead conjure d8 undead minions (equal to your Soul Power dice, max STR or LVL); slain enemies in Range 8 rise as minions while below your cap. Command them to Move and Attack for 1 Action.

LEVEL 7

Reanimation Rites. A Rite menu (Ravage, Feast) spending an undead minion’s Soul Touched to command the horde; consumed minions leave exploitable corpses.

LEVEL 11

Twitchy. Enemies leaving a space adjacent to a minion take STR damage. Ignores armor.

LEVEL 15

Death Nova. (1/Round) Free Reaction: a destroyed minion can unleash Ruin or Haunt on all adjacent enemies for free.
